phases.title: Slide and bump
phases.try: Slide your penguin around and bump a dummy into the sea.

phases.title: Rivals and cracks
phases.try: Survive three rivals while the ice cracks under you.

phases.title: Orca show
phases.try: Play full rounds with splashes, squawks and the goofy orca.

sentence: penguins pushing each other off an iceberg
title: Penguin Push

brief.rules: Last penguin on the iceberg wins the round; best of three rounds. The ice shrinks every 20 s.
brief.arena: A round iceberg, 30 m across, in open sea; edge rings crack and sink.
brief.ai: Three rival penguins pick a target every 3 s, the leader more often.
brief.controls: WASD steer the belly slide, Space hops over a shove.
brief.mood: Bright, splashy and silly: big splashes, squawks, a cheering seal crowd.
brief.pitch: Hop and bump three rivals off a shrinking iceberg while a goofy orca circles.

aspects.title: Tiny rockhopper
aspects.line: Hops over shoves, but flies far when hit.
aspects.detail: You steer a penguin that slides on its belly. Holding brake digs the flippers in for a sharp turn; a full-speed slide is hard to stop, so the edge is always close.

alternatives.title: Heavy emperor
alternatives.line: Slow to start, almost impossible to push over.

alternatives.title: Belly slider
alternatives.line: Belly-slide fast, brake with your flippers to turn.

aspects.title: Three rival penguins
aspects.line: They gang up on whoever leads the round.
aspects.detail: Three computer penguins. Each picks a target every few seconds; the leader gets picked more often, so a lead is hard to keep and a comeback is always possible.

alternatives.title: Every bird alone
alternatives.line: Each rival shoves whoever is nearest.

alternatives.title: Two against two
alternatives.line: You and a buddy penguin against a pair.

aspects.title: Shrinking iceberg
aspects.line: Cracks spread from the edges every twenty seconds.
aspects.detail: A round iceberg about thirty metres across. Every twenty seconds a ring of ice at the edge cracks and sinks, so the fight moves to the middle.

alternatives.title: Drifting floes
alternatives.line: Small floes drift apart; jump the gaps.

alternatives.title: Ice bowl
alternatives.line: A slippery bowl that tips everyone to the middle.

alternatives.title: Icebreaker deck
alternatives.line: A tilting ship deck that rolls with the waves.

aspects.title: Last one standing
aspects.line: Push the others into the sea; best of three rounds.
aspects.detail: A round ends when one penguin is left on the ice. Three rounds; the winner of two takes the match.

alternatives.title: Fish grab
alternatives.line: Most fish when the time runs out wins.

alternatives.title: Hold the crown
alternatives.line: Keep the crown longest; a bump knocks it loose.

aspects.title: Goofy orca
aspects.line: A clumsy orca flops onto the ice where it cracks.
aspects.detail: Crazy mode adds an orca. Its fin circles the iceberg; where it leaps, the ice breaks and any penguin there is thrown high. Lure rivals onto its path.

alternatives.title: Seal surfers
alternatives.line: Seals ride in on waves and shove everyone.

alternatives.title: Sudden blizzard
alternatives.line: Snow hides the edge; listen for the cracks.
